title: Text: DET Matt Boyd ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Hey please don’t make me sound like an idiot with my quotes on the sickness lol
I wasn’t trying to do that ...first day back and I’m getting myself in trouble
Haha I know you weren’t /aren’t...just figured I’d reach out before you wrote something.
Haha did I sound like one????
I apologize if I made  you sound like one, my tone can come off as sarcastic on Twitter
Ok lol I haven’t seen twitter. But no worries. Hardly ever a tone with 145 characters. All perception. All good

And if you ever do see something I wrote or said that’s too much (on the team or any of you guys), please let me know. I won’t take offense. I was gonna tell a few of you in person but that’s limited right now
I won’t take offense. It’s a balance and if the team is struggling I want to be conscious of not going too hard on the young guys
Thanks Anthony I’ll keep that in mind. I appreciate that. Thanks for that
